title: O-TRAVELZ Round 2 Research Source
description: Schema for a source record documenting evidence for one or more candidate fields. One source does not need to prove everything — use multiple source records per candidate.

source_id.description: Unique ID for this source record. Recommended format: {research_id}_src_{N}. Example: round2_east_001_src_1

research_id.description: The research_id of the candidate this source supports.

source_type.description: Type of source. 'government' = state/central government portal. 'tourism' = OTDC or official tourism body. 'asi' = Archaeological Survey of India. 'osm' = OpenStreetMap. 'wikimedia' = Wikimedia Commons (image source). 'wikipedia' = Wikipedia article (use for description context only; verify against primary sources). 'institutional' = university, reserve, museum, etc. 'news' = established news outlet. 'other' = document reason in notes.

title.description: Title of the source page or document.

url.description: URL of the source. Must be a full URL.

accessed_at.description: Date this source was accessed. ISO date format: YYYY-MM-DD.

supports.description: Which fields of the candidate record this source provides evidence for.

notes.description: Free-text notes: what specifically this source documents, quality notes, or caveats.
